title: Schedule Slack messages with AI for the right local time
h1: queue a slack message for later
description: Queue a Slack message for the start of someone else’s day. Choose the channel, thread and local delivery time before the bot schedules it.
answer: **write it on friday. let slack deliver it when the monday shift starts.** a bot can queue a channel message, direct message or thread reply for a future time. give the destination, wording, time and time zone. once queued, slack posts it later without another yes, so review the note before scheduling.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: choose the time before it is queued.
what:
**your working day need not become someone else’s notification.** slack accepts future messages up to 120 days ahead. give your local time zone; the bot handles the conversion. delivery must still be in the future when it queues.

the connected account must belong to the destination channel. for a thread, link the original message. layout attachments mean formatting here; document uploads need another action.
uses: **respect a later shift.** queue a reminder for when colleagues start.
**prepare workshop instructions.** schedule the reviewed text in the session thread.
**time an office closure notice.** write it during your working day for delivery later.

routine.message:
every friday at 14:40, prepare this note for #larkvale-studio: "please put monday’s equipment requests in the booking list".

- show the text and channel here
- propose delivery next monday at 08:45 europe/london
- wait for my agreement before scheduling

after queueing, report the confirmed delivery time here. if the result is unclear, look for the queued note before trying again. never queue a second copy blindly.
routine.when: fridays at 14:40; monday delivery follows your review
routine.needs: slack connected with read and write; membership in #larkvale-studio
routine.output:
larkvale studio reminder
channel: #larkvale-studio
delivery: monday, 08:45 europe/london
preview ready: the booking-list reminder will enter the queue after your agreement.

steps: **allow scheduling deliberately.** connect slack with read and write for this bot.
**name the destination.** give the channel and local time zone. link the parent message for a thread reply.
**require a pause.** say "wait for my agreement before scheduling"; send approval does not cover queueing.
**open the queued note.** confirm its delivery time before setting a weekly reminder.
watch: **past times fail.** so do dates beyond 120 days ahead.
**private channels still need membership.** a name does not grant access.
**link previews may still appear.** avoid links whose preview could reveal private details.

faq.q: will send approval stop it from scheduling?
faq.a: **no, scheduling counts as a write.** tell the bot to wait for your agreement before it queues anything.

faq.q: can it attach a document to the scheduled note?
faq.a: **not through this action.** it schedules message content and layout. uploading a file takes a separate action.

steps: choose one channel you belong to
write a short note and tomorrow’s local delivery time
ask the bot to preview it without queueing
read the text, channel and time zone before allowing it

mistakes.mistake: trusting "ask every time" for scheduled notes
mistakes.fix: add a wait-for-agreement instruction. scheduling does not use send approval.
state the time zone and compare it with the confirmed delivery time.

checklist.h: before the note enters the queue
items: the destination is the right channel or thread
the text is ready for other people to read
the local time and time zone are explicit
the bot will look for a queued note after an unclear result before retrying

tip.text: review the note before queueing. slack will not ask you again when delivery time arrives.
